parsed.observations: Grass specimens have dense cylindrical, bristly seed heads unlike wheat spikes. Leaves show yellowing and brown necrotic patches; stems or sheaths have reddish-brown discoloration. Distinct raised pustules, diagnostic black dots, and white powdery growth are not clearly visible.
parsed.summary: The specimens appear to be non-wheat grasses with leaf necrosis and stem or sheath discoloration, but visible evidence does not establish any allowed disease.
